method: sample base matrices reproducing theta_12 and Dm21/Dm31 at eta=0; for each, fit eta to theta_13 = 8.54 and record the predicted |theta_23 - 45|. The spread is the honest prediction band.
verdict: both bands contain the observation: the test does NOT discriminate once base-matrix freedom is marginalised -- Pass 264's point estimate was over-confident
reading: Pass 264 fired the one-parameter test at a single best-fit base and concluded that mode B (mu-mu/tau-tau breaking) is selected. This witness marginalises over the base-matrix freedom to see whether that conclusion survives. Whatever the bands say is reported as such: a point estimate that dissolves under marginalisation would mean Pass 264 was over-confident, and that is worth knowing.
